## The fix (chosen shape + why)

1. **`GET /app/new?entry=draft|outline` (+`held`) serves the SPA shell** (`server.ts` — the operator's preferred shape; `SPA_DOCUMENT_ROUTES` already arms `/app/new` at the `onboarding` surface, `packages/contracts/src/spa.ts:150`). The in-router leaf (`app.new.tsx`) then issues the ONE create POST and hands `held` to `/p/:slug/import`. A GET still never creates — the leaf's POST does. Bare/other-entry GETs keep the R7HOME.2b server redirect (a bookmark/refusal bounce never mints).
2. **Consume-once = clear `signup_intent` on first honor** — chosen over the leaf-arm-only alternative because the ticket's AC is literal: *a subsequent `/app` GET must not force-redirect again.* Only clearing satisfies that even when the create fails or the user deletes every project. Mechanism: api `POST /showcase/intent/consume` (`project-list.ts`, the intent's owning route file — `user` is an account table, self-scoped `where id = $1`, `rhema_app` already holds `update` per 0025) → `consumeSignupIntent` in `packages/api-client` + `apps/web/src/data.ts` → `GET /app` awaits it as it redirects (non-fatal on error — the `?entry=` params carry the intent verbatim regardless).
3. **Leaf failure arm `redirect({ href: "/app" })` → `redirect({ to: "/app" })`** (`app.new.tsx`) — the second mechanism too, as deploy-skew defense: while any stored intent lingers (a consume that raced or a deploy that skipped it), a document GET of `/app` would bounce straight back; the in-router nav renders the list directly and cannot re-loop.

## Regressions (all failed on pre-fix code, verified)

- `apps/web/src/signup-redirect.test.ts` (new, 19 tests) — **8 failed pre-fix**: the loop chain never resolved to 200; `consumeSignupIntent` never called; `/app/new?entry=draft`/`outline` never served the shell. **All 19 pass post-fix** — every auth landing URL (`/app?entry=draft&held=1`, `/app?entry=outline`, `/app?entry=scratch`, `/app`, the OAuth callback target `/app?entry=draft&held=1&src=hero`) reaches 200 in ≤2 hops for Showcase-only AND own-project users; intent consumed exactly once; bare `/app/new`, `entry=scratch`, `held`-only keep the server redirect; unauthenticated still 302s `/login`.
- `apps/api/src/showcase.test.ts` — `POST /showcase/intent/consume` clears `user.signup_intent` (visible via `GET /showcase` intent before/after), idempotent, 401 unauthenticated.
- `apps/web/src/spa/onboarding.dom.test.tsx` — the refused-create arm lands on the mounted `/app` list leaf (its `/bff/app` twin read) with zero document navigations.

## Browser evidence — the local N1/N3 arm

`packages/journeys/src/signup-redirect.local.test.ts` (new) — the local arm of the N1/N3 post-auth chain against the real build (`apps/web/dist/main.js`) + a minimal stub api (session rides the dev/preview `x-rhema-*` identity shim; the hold is planted by the REAL landing drop-zone island in the same browser context — N1's one-context rule). Asserted in real Chromium: `/app?entry=draft&held=1` → shell → exactly ONE create POST + exactly ONE consume → `/p/<slug>/import` → `input[name=file]` hydrated with `n1-held-draft.md` + `data-held-notice` names it → a later `/app` lands the §5.2 list (never `/app/new`) → zero `/app/new` document fetches beyond the handoff. **Passes post-fix; the identical walk loops forever pre-fix.**

Real N1/N3 (the deployed legs: real magic-link email + Gmail DWD mailbox + Resend) cannot run in this environment — no GCP WI credentials, no mail transport, no Postgres. That leg is Stage-B: the post-deploy arm in the ticket's deploy section (post-deploy N1/N3 + manual GET of the redirect chain) covers it.

## Judgement calls

- Consume endpoint placed in `createShellRoutes` beside the `GET /showcase` intent read (the owning route file); named `POST /showcase/intent/consume` — a real write, not a side-effecting GET.
- `entry=scratch` deliberately NOT served the shell — `/app` never redirects a scratch intent there (§15.3: the unopened Showcase wins over scratch), so the server redirect stays the honest landing.
- Refusal-redirect URLs from `POST /app/new` (`/app/new?entry=draft` form-mode bounces) now also serve the shell → auto-create scratch. Accepted: the SSR sheet is deleted (SPA.27), so no served document can emit a form POST; the JSON arms answer `{error}` objects, never these redirects. The alternative (a marker param) was rejected — it would break N1's verbatim `gotoOk("/app/new?entry=draft&held=1")` revisit contract.
